description: Read-only. Return the 11-question Delx Wellness onboarding flow (en or pt-BR), the current shared profile, missing critical fields, and a cross-connector hint. Use this when the user starts a fresh wellness session and you need to fill out preferred_name, goals, devices, training context, nutrition, preferences, and safety. Strava continues to redact GPS by default — onboarding does not change that.
